gaps.detail: New color conversion fixture waits for checked procedure/type dependencies; screenshot stops at non-scalar module-parameter typed resolution; text/UI stops at GL modifier syntax. No new assertions finished. Exact diagnostics/hashes are preserved.

Actual native APIs, libraries, contexts, hardware, ABI layouts and symbols are not acceptance-tested. Screenshot begin/end/cancel require the same current context; finish readers before shutdown. No original native executable, library or asset was copied or executed.

Screenshot has explicit end/cancel lifetime, no implicit context-shutdown registry cleanup or cross-thread support. Texture registries and per-thread immediate state lack complete application teardown.

LCD coverage is averaged into ordinary alpha; no dual-source blending, shaping, grapheme navigation, dithering or legacy glyph substitutions. Invisible-glyph highlight and selected-tab markers are unfinished. CPU nearest sampling differs from GL linear sampling.

NONE and METAL fail explicitly for rendering. Screenshot supports eight-bit component destinations and ordinary 2D sources; unsupported requests fail begin. Format sizing does not imply upload support. No assets bundled.

Bulk UI consumes Routed_Input_Event, routed_events_this_frame and unrouted_events_this_frame from the separate authored Input packet. Merge both together. Unassociated events cannot establish native multiwindow origin.

Cosmetic timing fields are not all applied. Authored radial warp, palettes and interpolation boundaries do not claim original appearance or formula parity. Delayed occlusion registration and popup/input integration are not behavior-tested; native stock diagonals on older AppKit use a documented closed-hand fallback. Float64 slider arithmetic still loses precision for very large integers.

Actual older RH consumers require an explicit versioned module-search overlay with real upward-positive geometry and UI. Default maintained GetRect22 and historical LH265 are not aliases for that surface; a separate geometry/UI packet is being authored.
